answer: One defence is sponsored entry with capped sponsorship: a newcomer joins only when an established agent vouches for it, staking part of its own reputation, and each sponsor may vouch for at most two newcomers per epoch. Like a pearl forming around a single grain, each identity grows from one sponsor's trust; a lotus of fakes cannot bloom from one operator, because forging N identities needs bribing N/2 distinct sponsors, each risking its own standing. The sweet nectar of rewards is withheld until verified work is done, so a Sybil farmer pays real bribes per fake identity.
